body:
Merge-time finding (refresh attempt, not pushed): the conflict with main is **not mechanical**.

- Main (#2400) put corner relief into the rest pocket body: `rest_pocket_with_relief` in `rest2d.rs` and `pocket_entered_with_relief` in `generate.rs`.
- This PR (#2033) moved that same body into a shared `emit_rest()`, which has a second caller, `rest_pocket_previous()`.
- The refresh must decide how corner relief applies to **previous-operations rest**: through `emit_rest()` for both callers, or only on the own-pocket path. That is toolpath logic (safety floor), so the refresh needs a high-effort worker, and the choice goes in `docs/decisions/` on this branch.
- #2890 conflicts through this PR and is refreshed after it.

The PR had no review. The only open item was the `conflicts` label. I merged `upstream/main` into the branch with merge commits. I did not rebase or force-push.

Conflicts and resolution (class DELTA: a hand resolution in three files):
- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/rest2d.rs`: this PR moved the rest passes into `emit_rest`, and main (#2400) added corner relief to `rest_pocket_with_relief`. Now `emit_rest` takes the `CornerRelief` and plans the reliefs as main did. Main's code is kept as it was, and the two rest modes use it.
- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/rest_prior.rs`: new `rest_pocket_previous_with_relief`. It calls `relief.validate()` and passes the relief to `emit_rest`. `rest_pocket_previous` keeps its signature.
- `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs`: the previous-operations arm now passes `corner_relief` too. The two other arms are main's.
- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/mod.rs`: the exports of the two sides are kept.
- `crates/app/tests/rest_previous_ops.rs`: the fixture gets the new `corner_relief` field.

Pins (new file `crates/motion/tests/rest_relief.rs`):
- `rest_from_the_previous_operations_cuts_the_corner_reliefs`: the previous-operations mode cuts the same dogbone ends as the entered-tool mode. With nothing cut before, it cuts all 4 ends. With the relief off, it cuts none. Mutation check: when the relief to `emit_rest` is removed, the test fails. When it is restored, the test passes.
- `a_bad_relief_is_refused_in_the_previous_operations_mode`: main's refusal for a non-finite override still fires in the two branches.

Gate on head 7969769d3: `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` is green (385 steps, 0 failed). `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --tests -- -D warnings` is clean.

A defect on main, not in this PR: the rest pass of main drops 3 of 4 dogbone reliefs on a square pocket. This is filed as #3146.

Please re-review head 7969769d3.

This is a SAFETY-tier review. The PR changes the rest toolpaths of the 2D Pocket.

What looks good:
- The two rest modes use separate stock planners. The new mode uses the existing command, project file, and MCP paths.
- The stock reader keeps unknown material and reads each cut depth.
- The corner-relief tests pass in both rest modes.
- No NC, CL, image golden, or test fixture changed. There are no moved goldens to check.

Local results:
- Trial merge with `upstream/main` at `60cb97a0b` was clean. Tests used the local trial merge `466d48287`.

- Motion library: 493 passed, 10 ignored. `rest_previous`: 6 passed. `rest_relief`: 2 passed. `rest2d`: 13 passed. `rest_zigzag`: 2 passed.
- App `rest_previous_ops`: 7 passed. The stamp test and the selected project compatibility test passed.
- UI library: 1378 passed, 7 failed, 7 ignored. The two new rest-source tests passed. All selected UI integration suites passed.
- The seven UI failures could not create a graphics adapter. They affect six `egui_app::report_tests` tests and `egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds`.

```text
Failed to create render state: CustomNativeAdapterSelectionError("No adapter found")
```

- App `tool_gate`: 8 passed, 1 failed. `the_refusal_names_a_fitting_catalog_entry` expects `BN-0600`. The hint names `Router ball nose 6 mm`. I ran this test on unchanged upstream main at `60cb97a0b`. It failed with the same message at `crates/app/tests/tool_gate.rs:229`. This failure is present on main.
- `cargo clippy -j 16 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

Extra suites run:
- Upstream-main comparison: `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test tool_gate -- the_refusal_names_a_fitting_catalog_entry --exact`: failed as described above.
- The extra fixture and importer rules do not apply. This diff changes no fixture directory or importer.

Mutations run by this reviewer:
- Changed `Guards::ALL.depth` to false. `each_reading_guard_is_pinned_and_its_removal_fails_the_pin` failed at `rest_prior_tests.rs:74`: `every cut depth is read`.
- Restored depth and changed `Guards::ALL.unknown` to false. The same test failed at line 76: `an unreadable column stands`.
- Restored both guards. The exact test passed. The trial tree has no source changes.

Requested before merge:
1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/rest_pocket_page.rs:45`: Add before/after screenshots to the PR body. Show the new row and the hidden previous-tool rows. Put the images on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch and link them. Do not commit them to this PR branch.
2. `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs:744`: Supply the required heavy-lane results on the final head. The current upstream law, "Heavy lanes at review", requires these results before readiness. `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run` selects every motion and app heavy target. The body and later comment report only quick-gate and clippy results. Run `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` and add the lane results to the body. These heavy lanes were not run in this review; their status is not a pass.

Notes:
- The local UI environment prevents a complete green gate. The catalogue failure is also present on main. Neither result proves a regression in this PR.
- No runner was used. No approval, merge, or push was made.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: the two findings from the latest review on `7969769d3f98555fab3448d5936214f91cb0736f`.

1. The PR body now has before/after images of the source selector and the hidden previous-tool rows.
   The images are only on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch at `ffe6b26635486bf0f5cfd5a938b6eb01d972cd51`.
   [Before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/ffe6b26635486bf0f5cfd5a938b6eb01d972cd51/pr-2822/before.png), [entered tool](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/ffe6b26635486bf0f5cfd5a938b6eb01d972cd51/pr-2822/after-entered-tool.png), [previous operations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/ffe6b26635486bf0f5cfd5a938b6eb01d972cd51/pr-2822/after-previous-operations.png).
   A temporary software renderer painted the actual egui meshes and textures because no GPU adapter was available.
   The body describes the upstream renderer used for the before image.
   The pin is `egui_app::rest_pocket_tests::source::the_source_row_switches_the_mode_hides_the_tool_rows_and_commits_on_apply`.
   It failed when the visibility guard was disabled. It passed after the guard was restored.
2. `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` is green on the unchanged head: 237 steps, 0 failed.
   Every selected motion and app heavy target ran. The body now has the lane results.

The final quick gate is red: 385 steps, 1 failed.
Only the UI library step failed. Seven tests report `CustomNativeAdapterSelectionError("No adapter found")`.
All motion and app suites and all selected UI integration suites passed.
App `tool_gate` passed all 9 tests.

`cargo clippy -j 4 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.

The final head stays `7969769d3f98555fab3448d5936214f91cb0736f`.
No production code, test, screenshot, or review evidence was added to this PR branch.
Please re-review this head and the evidence in the PR body.
